QuestInfo.name: A Harsh Joke
QuestInfo.0: There was no welcome, unless you count beatings. Phantom must be mad about that broken lock, or embarrassed that you found Aria's picture. Though he seems more than just angry...
QuestInfo.1: Phantom is treating you as a stranger and seems even more hostile when you bring up Aria. You first thought he was joking, but his eyes look very serious. What's happening?
QuestInfo.2: Phantom is treating you as a stranger and seems even more hostile when you bring up Aria. You first thought he was joking, but his eyes look very serious. What's happening?

1.0: Is Phantom playing a joke? No, those eyes... It was real. And even for him, this is going too far. Then what does this mean?
1.1: I can't make any assumptions. Maybe Phantom IS playing a joke... A very vicious, violent joke. It's been hundreds of years, and things have changed. Or maybe he just didn't recognize me...
1.2: I'll have to go see Luminous. That will help. I...really hope it's not what I think it is. I'm sure it isn't...
